blob.description: The content key of the bytes these rows describe

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed: `json` strict (no comments, no trailing commas), `jsonc` with comments and trailing commas, `yaml` as a YAML 1.2 stream under the core schema (every document, aliases expanded, `<<` a plain key), `ini` an `.npmrc` read by npm's `ini` package as one object holding only its allowlisted top-level keys (every other key and every section dropped)

doc.description: 0-based document ordinal within the file; JSON has one, 0; a YAML stream 0..n-1

seq.description: 0-based position among the document's conditions, in the order the parse reported them

node.description: The ordinal of the node the condition is about, or null

code.description: `DATA_DUPLICATE_KEY`: a key repeated in one object (the later member wins); `DATA_LOSSY_NUMBER`: a number whose lexeme's exact value differs from that of its double, or whose double is not finite; `DATA_NON_STRING_KEY`: a YAML key that is not a string (a number, boolean, null or collection), keyed by its source text

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break
